rule: This file ranks downstream risk translations only. It does not authorize a live rule or a statistical test.

why_first: Exact-JNU Stage B reconfirmed after DI3 on 25 events with P=1.000.
Discrete official event state keeps translation degrees of freedom low.
Low turnover and no need to alter directional vote.
Official MPM dates are known in advance.
priority.pit_issue: Exact Statement release time is not known before the meeting ends; the 2026-09-18 BOJ schedule lists it as undecided. Therefore a live release-minus-10-minute start would leak future information.

timing_only_diagnostic.sample: regular/scheduled MPM decision releases 2016-2026, excluding the clearly unscheduled 2020-03-16 and 2020-05-22 meetings

design_seed_not_formally_frozen.release_end_rule: Continue until 20 minutes after the official policy decision/Statement release is actually observed.
design_seed_not_formally_frozen.fail_safe: If official release is not observed, keep new-entry blackout through the OSE day-session close.

before_formal_test: Freeze one primary utility/risk objective and opportunity-cost metric.
Validate PIT release-detection plumbing without price-based timestamp inference.
Do not test alternate start clocks, post-release lengths, size cuts, stop widening or forced exits in parallel.

why_second: Long true-OSE evidence and exact-JNU Stage B pass exist.
Continuous sizing creates materially more degrees of freedom than a discrete event blackout.
Exact-JNU QLIKE bootstrap was 0.522 while MSE bootstrap was 0.9685; the frozen Stage-B rule passed, but translation should remain conservative.
No validated directional base strategy currently exists for measuring sizing utility and opportunity cost.
priority.allowed_first_translation: One exposure-cap mapping only; do not combine sizing, stop distance and confidence changes.

shared_blocker: No validated directional entry module exists. Stage-4 risk translations can be designed now, but final operational utility must eventually be tested with a valid exposure/entry process rather than by claiming trivial risk reduction from simply trading less.
